framework_step: Design · Step 2 of 9: Establish the Unified Data Asset Inventory & Entity-Relationship Model

ivr_telephony_edge_runtime.classification: Layer 1 Telephony Edge & Real-Time Voice Agent Runtime
ivr_telephony_edge_runtime.underlying_engine: Open-Source VoicEra Real-Time Voice Platform (COSS-India/voicera_mono_repository — SIP/PSTN + Pipecat Runtime + MinIO/PostgreSQL)
ivr_telephony_edge_runtime.hosting_provenance: Self-Hosted Sovereign State Telecom Edge (<₹1/min full-stack benchmark)
ivr_telephony_edge_runtime.##_rationale: Answers inbound/outbound 8kHz PSTN/SIP feature-phone calls, manages bidirectional audio streaming, Voice Activity Detection (VAD), turn-taking, and barge-in interruption, stores sovereign .wav call recordings in MinIO, and forwards validated 8kHz/16kHz sessions to Layer 1 IvrConnector while delegating stateless ASR/TTS inference to Layer 3 BHASHINI.

speech_to_text_block.classification: Layer 3 Foundational Multimodal AI Model API (Stateless ASR)
speech_to_text_block.underlying_engine: Digital India BHASHINI ASR Model Cluster (ULCA / DIBD / AI4Bharat REST & WebSocket APIs)
speech_to_text_block.##_rationale: Stateless Speech-to-Text model API that transcribes 8kHz narrowband PSTN/GSM (captured by the upstream Layer 1 VoicEra telephony runtime) and 16kHz wideband PCM audio streams into Indic vernacular text across 22 Scheduled languages.

text_translation_block.classification: Layer 3 Foundational Multimodal AI Model API (Stateless NMT)
text_translation_block.underlying_engine: Digital India BHASHINI NMT Model Cluster
text_translation_block.##_rationale: Stateless Neural Machine Translation model API that translates unstructured regional agricultural dialects into standardized administrative English strings.

text_to_speech_block.classification: Layer 3 Foundational Multimodal AI Model API (Stateless TTS)
text_to_speech_block.underlying_engine: Digital India BHASHINI TTS Model Cluster
text_to_speech_block.##_rationale: Stateless Text-to-Speech model API that synthesizes outbound confirmation strings into vernacular speech for playback over the Layer 1 SIP / VoicEra telephony runtime.

entity_extraction_block.underlying_engine: Local Fine-Tuned SLM via Ollama Framework Core
entity_extraction_block.hosting_provenance: Sovereign Local Hardware Instance (MacBook Pro Silicon Pool)
entity_extraction_block.##_governance_rationale: Running a localized SLM keeps citizen text processing completely within sovereign physical compute boundaries, preventing cloud PII leakage vectors.

identity_registry_rail.system_name: Sovereign Digital Identity Engine (Aadhaar / MOSIP Pattern Core)
identity_registry_rail.source_of_truth_for: Citizen Identity Verification & Tokenized String Extraction Validation
identity_registry_rail.##_security_note: Enforces the cryptographic boundary where cleartext identifiers convert into irreversible tokenized hashes.

agricultural_data_rail.source_of_truth_for: Cadastral land boundaries, geofenced plots, and seasonal crop sown records
agricultural_data_rail.##_architecture_note: AI outputs only inform eligibility decisions; this registry remains the sole authoritative source of truth for updating benefit balances.

social_protection_registry_dpg.source_of_truth_for: Subsidy claim case lifecycle management, status states, and human-in-the-loop fallback routing logs

payment_disbursement_rail.system_name: NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) / Mojaloop Ledger Rail
payment_disbursement_rail.source_of_truth_for: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) execution clearing numbers
